sentences.en: Are frogs reptiles? I don't expect them to be mammals.
sentences.zh: 青蛙是爬行动物吗？我不指望它们是哺乳动物。

sentences.en: Some reptiles have a plain body, others a scaly body.
sentences.zh: 有些爬行动物身体平滑，而另一些则有鳞片。

sentences.en: Reptiles are more closely related to mammals than to amphibians.
sentences.zh: 爬行动物与哺乳动物的关系比与两栖动物更近。

senses.zh: 爬行动物；（非正式）卑鄙的人
